unleserlich.et: From un- + leserlich. Further analysable as un- + lesen + -er- + -lich.

unleugbar.et: Equivalent to un- + leugbar. See the latter.

unlieb.et: From Middle High German unliep, from Old High German unliob, from Proto-West Germanic *unleub, from Proto-Germanic *unleubaz. Equivalent to un- + lieb. Cognate with English unlief.
